# Pack Manifest Changes

Read the [pack manifest reference](../../docs/developer/packs/reference/manifest.md)
and the [manifest schema specification](../../openspec/specs/manifest-schemas/spec.md).
Keep manifests compatible with `projects/schema/pack.schema.json`; update the
schema, validation tests, and documentation together when the manifest contract
changes.
